text: My main symptom is Significant rapid breathing. I also have Appears unwell, Diminished appetite, No fever, Swelling in the legs. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Multiple sclerosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I must clarify that Multiple Sclerosis is extremely rare in a 3-year-old and does not typically present with rapid breathing or leg swelling; these symptoms suggest a cardiac or hepatic issue. Please confirm if the child has been gaining weight recently or if the swelling has spread to the belly?
